Use `Text.from_markup(value).plain` to get the visible text without its style tags, then search that string. `Text.from_markup` is documented in the [markup docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst). For usage questions, Rich's [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) are the right place.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
